A signature ELYMONS feature

Two parents.
A brand-new possibility.

Breeding lets two eligible Elymons create an offspring. Their elements and traits influence the next generation, opening the door to hybrid discoveries, unique appearances, and family-line stories.

✓
Hybrid elementsCross-element parents can produce special combinations.
✓
Trait inheritanceOffspring can inherit visual and genetic traits from both parents.
✓
Family lineageTrack parent IDs, generations, and mutations.
Breeding fees, cooldowns, eligibility, and mutation rates will be finalized and tested before launch.

Our economy philosophy: gameplay comes first. Any future token or rewards model will need transparent emissions, meaningful in-game sinks, anti-bot protections, a funded rewards budget, and independent security review. No earnings or financial returns are promised. Token names, tickers, supply, and launch plans are not finalized.
The journey ahead

Growing one milestone at a time.

A development path from the first playable prototype to a connected creature ecosystem.

PHASE 01 · FOUNDATION

World & Creatures

PHASE 02 · PLAYABLE MVP

PHASE 03 · BREEDING

PHASE 04 · WEB3

Elysium Integration

Good to know

Frequently asked questions

What is ELYMONS?

ELYMONS is a planned colorful 2D creature-collecting RPG with elemental companions, 3v3 turn-based battles, progression, and hybrid breeding.

Do I need an NFT to play?

The intended design is free-to-play access for everyone, with optional NFT ownership for supported blockchain features.

How does hybrid breeding work?

Two eligible parents can produce offspring. Their elements and traits influence the hybrid. Exact genetics, costs, limits, and mutation rules are still being designed.

Which blockchain will ELYMONS use?

ELYMONS is being designed for Kinetiq Elysium. Wallet and contract integration will follow testnet development and security review.

Can players earn tokens?

A sustainable rewards model is under consideration. No token, earnings, or financial returns are promised.

Is the game live?

ELYMONS is in active development. The website presents the project vision; online services, NFT features, marketplace, and blockchain integrations are not live yet.
